description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Delete' feature of articles in a C# ASP.NET Core project. It defines test cases to verify the deletion of articles under various conditions, including deletion with tags and comments.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the delete article feature, including cases with tags and comments.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Test case that creates and deletes an article, then verifies the article no longer exists.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Test case that creates an article with tags, deletes it, and verifies it is removed.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Test case that creates an article with a comment, deletes the article, and verifies it has been removed.
